_note: 2026-09-27 3体目の幕ボス (古機＝金属質): 巻き上げ機の番人 (幕2・本家 Bronze Automaton)・技封じの絡繰 (その取り巻き)・熾を喰う古炉 (幕3・本家 Hexaghost)。各2シード (23,41) から選ぶ。技封じの絡繰は 48×48（64 だと番人と同じ大きさに見えた＝絵の大きさ×4px で描くため）
style: pixel art of an ancient mining automaton that was never switched off, still working in a buried city, body of tarnished pale metal plates and worn stone with visible rivets, brass cogs and a taut cable, hard straight edges and crisp metallic highlights, thin dark ink outline, one small pale glowing lens where a face would be, no mouth, no fur, no animal features, cold patient and a little sad, palette of cream paper, tarnished silver, weathered brass, dusty blue-grey slate and ink, low contrast

items.description: an old MINE WINCH machine that became a guardian: a squat heavy iron frame on four short riveted legs, a big horizontal cable drum wound thick with taut steel cable on its back, a large crank wheel on its side, a hooked boom arm raised high like a small crane, a round brass barrel set in the front plate for firing a beam, a small pale glowing lens above the barrel, {style}
